notes.envelope_count: Exactly7 keys listed by original array; prior prose saying8 was a counting typo. No wire field changes.
notes.data_records: At most262144 per stream AND cumulative per worker lifetime. Descriptor stores sequence/offset/digest only, not repeated body. Original raw across each stream<=2MiB; pending transport<=4; fragment<=8KiB. Early complete events forwarded immediately, never wait to fill8KiB. Exact recorded duplicates idempotent; changed duplicate fails. Exhaustion returns original UNKNOWN and preserves counters.
notes.observations: Original<=262144 per stream plus cumulative per-worker262144 limit; hashes/descriptors bounded, <=4 pending; original configured max_calls and absolute32 unchanged.
notes.canonical: Both sides use existing RFC8785 canonical JSON. Go internal/canonical/jsontext.Value.Canonicalize; worker UTF16 key ordering and JSON.stringify. No HTML escape of <>&; U+2028/U+2029 retained; UTF8 bytes hashed with sha256: lowerhex prefix. Inputs reject duplicate object names, invalid Unicode and nonfinite numbers.
notes.initialization: Go Bridge.Acknowledge ordinary init frame persists ACK then writes with existing single writeMu; only successful actual Write sets private modelInitDelivered flag. Coordinator then inserts immutable command.initialize.delivered receipt into existing client_control_receipts, same initialized binding, original init_sequence and delivered=true. Coordinator processes subsequent MODEL only after this commit. stream.open and every observation recheck both barriers. Worker accepts open only after actual matching ordinary command.initialize ACK; no advertised field or public schema added.
notes.terminal: No terminal SDK output is required before ordinary final effect ACK. terminal=true raw fragments withheld until original durable CONFIRMED+stream.terminal marker+exact ordinaryACK. text_end remains staging; publicEND still final artifact/Run reconciliation only.
notes.storage: Additional receipt kinds are private fixed runtime records, not public REPORT tags or schema/table changes; existing backup/restore validators must be checked for every newkind. No credential-bearing original raw persisted on quarantine rejection.
